mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_read_history (user_id, book_id, chapter_id, chapter_num, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterNum}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.user_id, h.book_id, h.chapter_id, h.chapter_num, h.update_time, b.book_name FROM user_read_history h LEFT JOIN book_info b ON b.id = h.book_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.update_time DESC
